_meta.about: One reasoning card per technique, written from the vendored technique table (data/attck_techniques.json); each card names the table fields it was written from. requires: what the evidence has to show; kind: behaviour (the action alone is the technique) or intent (the action needs a stated adversarial purpose); indicators: what a reader looks for; siblings: the techniques it is confused with and the criterion that tells them apart. terms and distinct are match words, never shown to a model.

T1003.name: OS Credential Dumping

requires.what: credential material is read from the operating system: LSASS memory, the SAM or SECURITY hive, the domain database or the shadow file

indicators: a handle opened on lsass.exe with memory read access
MiniDumpWriteDump on another process
hive saves of SAM or SECURITY

siblings.criterion: the secrets come from an application's password store (a browser, a keychain, the credential manager), not from the operating system
the credentials sit in files, scripts or the registry in plain form
process or environment state is read to spot an analysis environment and no credential is taken

T1005.name: Data from Local System

requires.what: files or data on the local system are read and gathered for the sample's use or to be sent out

indicators: reads over user folders
a list of targeted file extensions
archives built from local files

siblings.criterion: files are only listed or searched and their contents are not taken
what is read is the system's configuration, not user data

T1006.name: Direct Volume Access

requires.what: a volume or disk is opened as a raw device and read around the file system

indicators: a device path such as \\.\PhysicalDrive0 opened for reading

siblings.criterion: the volume is only queried for its properties (its label, serial number or size)
the raw disk is written to destroy it

siblings.criterion: registry values are written or deleted, not only read

siblings.criterion: artefacts are hidden with ordinary attributes or locations and no operating-system component is changed

the change is made below the operating system, in firmware or boot records

siblings.criterion: the listing is of live connections, not of the host's configuration

the trust relationships of the domain are listed

siblings.criterion: what is read is the trust relationships between domains

siblings.criterion: the data goes over the command channel on the operator's request
